Title of the Research: SAFETY AND ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE OF MASS ADMINISTRATION OF AZITHROMYCIN IN CHILDREN 1- 59 MONTHS IN NIGERIA [SARMAAN II PROJECT] 
Ta’ken Wannan Bincike (اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُم): Tsaro da juriyar ƙwayoyin cuta ga magunguna a cikin raba Azithromycin ga yara yan wata daya (1) zuwa watanni hamsin da tara (59) a Najeriya (Aikin SARMAAN II)
بِنْبُكِي أَلْمَاكَن مَايَكَتُو لَفِيا تَفَسَر نَاجِيرِيا
دُومِن أَذَب كُو وَتَن مَاتَن أَرَيْرُومَايِسَن
غَا يَار مَاسُ وَت طَي )1 (Azithromycin)
زُو وَتِّبِي خَمَسَن دَتَر )59( أَنْفَانِسَ
.كَرَفَشَن أَيَكَن (SARMAAN II)
Name(s) and Affiliation(s) of Researchers (Sunan me bincik): Professor (Farfesa) Oliver Ezechi
Sponsor(s) of Research (Daukar nauyi): Federal Ministry of Health (Ma’aikatar Lafiya ta Tarayyan Najeriya)
Summary of Study Information (Takaitaccen bayanin wannan bincike) (بَيَانَن وَتَن بِنْبُكَن): 
1.	This study is being conducted by FMoH through SARMAAN in Nigeria to see if giving children a medicine called Azithromycin (AZM) can help reduce childhood illnesses and deaths as well as monitor antimicrobial resistance pattern. 
(Gudanar da wannan bincike alhakin  maaikatar lafiya ta tarayya ne domin a duba ko ba wa yara magani mai suna Azithromycin (AZM) zai taimaka wajen rage cututtuka da mace-macen yara, tare da sa ido kan juriyar ƙwayoyin cuta ga wannan maganin)
١ - كُو وَتَن مَاتَن زَي رَغِي يَاوَن مِنَّ مِتِّي غَ يَار

2.	The study will take place in eleven states where child deaths are high: Kebbi, Katsina, Sokoto, Bauchi, Adamawa, Kano, Yobe, Gombe, Zamfara, Jigawa and Kaduna. (wannan binciken zai gudana ne  a jihohi goma sha ɗaya in da mace macen kananan yara na fi yawa: Kebbi, Katsina, Sokoto, Bauchi, Adamawa, Kano, Yobe, Gombe, Zamfara, Jigawa da kuma Kaduna.)
٢ - أَيَكَن زَي غِرَان :- هُوكِيتُوم كِيسَم كَانُوم كَادُونَ، بَقِّيم، أَدَمَاوَ، بُويِي، جِيغَوَا، كَتَبِنَام دَ زَمْفَارَ

3.	All children aged 1 - 59 months in all the households, settlements, ward and LGAs will receive the medicine for free. However, for the research component, data and samples (nasopharyngeal and rectal samples) will be collected from children 1-59 months in 4,200 households 
(Dukan yara yan wata daya (1) zuwa watanni hamsin da tara (59) za su karɓi wannan maganin kyauta, a gidaje, shiyoyi, gunduma da karamar hukuma. Amma don bangaren bincike, za a tattara bayanai da samfurori (samples) daga yaran a gidaje 4,200)
٣ - رَا بَادَ وَتَن مَاتَن كُوتَا غَايَر وَت طَي (1) زُو وَتَن خَمَسَن دَيَار (59) أُغَادِجِيم، أَنْغُونَتَن غَندُومَا دَ قِنَان حَكُومُومِي وَ أَمَّا زَاءَ أَيَّشَ سَمْعُورِي(Samples)
أَيَّشَ سَمْعُورِي
دَا أَغَادِجِي دُوبُو حُطُو دَطَرِي يَبُو (4200)

4.	The study is at no cost to participants, and the interview will take about 25 minutes, with minimal risks in sample collection (nasopharyngeal and rectal) from eligible children. 
(Binciken kyauta ne, tattaunawa za ta ɗauki minti 25, kuma ba asaran wani haɗari ko cutarwa yayin ɗaukar samfurorin a wurin yaran da suka chanchanta)
٤ - خَنُوت زَاي وَتَن بِنْبَكَن، زَاي حِبَرَتَ مِن (25) يَيْن دُوكَر سَمْعُورِي

5.	The study will help improve child survival, if it eventually becomes a policy. 
(Binciken zai taimaka wajen inganta rayuwar yara idan ya zama tsari)
٥ - زَي تَيَّمَكَا وَجَن إَنَفَش رِيبُوز يَار

6.	All personal information will be kept private, and only authorised researchers will have access to study information. 
(Za a kiyaye bayanan sirri, kuma masu bincike da aka ba izini kaɗai za su gani)
٦ - زَاءُ رِقَتِي أَسِرَت كَّو

7.	Participation is completely voluntary, and you can stop at any time without any consequences. 
(Shiga cikin bincike se in mutun ya na so, kuma za ka iya janyewa a kowane lokaci)
